title: Rank and File
text: Each time a roaming <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion takes a wound, you may add a <symbol>sauron</symbol> token here. <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Exert an Uruk-hai or discard a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion to add a <symbol>sauron</symbol> token here. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Remove 2 <symbol>sauron</symbol> tokens from here to make a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion strength +2.
